verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI assistant that answers tax questions such as product taxability or why an invoice was taxed a certain way, and nothing about answers drawn from Numeral's rule base with citations. The MCP server only exposes account data (nexus, filings, transactions) to the user's own third-party AI client, which is the generic-chatbot pattern the story rules out. The Claude skills teach coding agents how to integrate the API, and 'AI product classification' is a different feature, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot
